text: Create #fractal-forge for Kenji, Olena, and Priya's generative art project using the team's GPU infrastructure.
Then set the new channel's topic to include 'GPU-meets-art'.
Invite Kenji, Olena, and Priya to the new channel.
Post an inaugural message in the new channel referencing the GPU-work discussions and circuit-tracer thread, using relevant messages written by Kenji, Olena, or Priya.
